notes: Product line includes pair SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX10D-35 (Tx/Rx 1310/1550 nm) and SO-SFP-1000BASE-BX10D-53 (Tx/Rx 1550/1310 nm). Standard operating temperature 0°C to +70°C; industrial (-I) option -40°C to +85°C. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Power budget 0 – 12dB. Transmitter output power and receiver min/overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload stated @ 1.25Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10^-12, PRBS 27-1, back-to-back (footnote 4). Transmit wavelength 1270–1350 nm and receiver wavelength 1530–1570 nm apply to -35; transmit 1500–1580 nm and receiver 1260–1360 nm apply to -53. Power consumption stated as < 1.0W.
suggestions: temp_min_c/temp_max_c are single floats but two operating grades (C-temp and I-temp) are explicit; consider paired temp ranges per SKU. DDM Yes is not in schema. Power budget 12 dB is only in overview/ordering, not a dedicated field.
